description: Mobile techniques used by Marcher, ATT&CK software S0317 (v1.0)
name: Marcher (S0317)

techniques.comment: [Marcher](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0317) has been delivered via a link sent by SMS or email, including instructions advising the user to modify their Android device security settings to enable applications to be installed from "Unknown Sources."(Citation: Proofpoint-Marcher)
